question: What discount rate was used to compute the NPV in the CO2-WAG stacking-learning optimization?
rendered: A discount rate of 7% was used to compute the NPV in the CO2-WAG stacking-learning optimization (Waste-derived mesoporous biochar for glycerol to glycerol carbonate upgrading: intensified process design and techno-economic analysis, page 5).
